# Çin'den Al Sat — China Import Consultancy

> China-to-US import consultancy. Supplier sourcing, quality control, customs, logistics, and private label services. Professional guidance for Turkish entrepreneurs and businesses importing from China to the United States.

## Services / Hizmetler

- [Import Consultancy / İthalat Danışmanlığı](/): Supplier sourcing, negotiation, quality control, customs and logistics consulting
- [Viral Products / Viral Ürünler](/viral-urunler/): 15 trending products in the US — Amazon retail price vs factory price comparison
- [Alibaba Trend Products / Alibaba Trend Ürünler](/alibaba-trend-urunler/): Top 15 products on Alibaba — real wholesale prices and supplier links
- [US Import Guide / ABD İthalat Rehberi](/abd-ithalat/): US import process, customs duties, ISF documentation, and compliance
- [Previous Projects / Önceki Projeler](/onceki-projeler/): Completed import and export projects

## Pricing Information / Fiyat Bilgileri

All products display two prices:
- **Amazon Price**: Average/high retail price in the US (USD)
- **Factory Price (Fabrika Çıkış Fiyatı)**: Lowest wholesale price from Alibaba (USD)
